experiment_rules.rule: Change one major variable at a time when sample size permits.
experiment_rules.anti_spam: Do not publish near-identical variants back-to-back unless isolating one variable.

trend_rule: Never label an audio/sound #1, viral, or currently trending without fresh platform evidence; otherwise use validated hook/format/visual trends.
current_learning: Curiosity-driven unusual action followed by a luxury/AI payoff is the current LUNA retention hypothesis; test 3-5 controlled variations before declaring it a winner.
integrity: Existing v2 binary retrieval, immutable masters, hashing, frame extraction, registry and identity-gate rules remain mandatory.
